articles.title: AT&T Diversity Lawsuit Puts Governance And Valuation In Investor Focus
articles.mainIdea: AT&T Diversity Lawsuit Puts Governance And Valuation In Investor Focus
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: AT&T Diversity Lawsuit Puts Governance And Valuation In Investor Focus. New York City pension funds have filed a lawsuit against AT&T (NYSE:T) over the company’s decision not to allow a shareholder vote on a workforce diversity disclosure proposal. The case centers on whether investors can require AT&T to provide more detailed reporting on the composition of its workforce and related diversity metrics.
